dossier.summary: Tidewater Freight sells freight visibility software to mid-market shippers. It tracks loads across carriers and flags late deliveries before the customer calls.
dossier.why_now: Grew its outbound team from two SDRs to six this quarter.

data.event_name: Cold email after this year's inbox rules
data.host: Jonah Feld and Rae Morgan, Signalgrid
data.guests: About forty RevOps and sales leaders from logistics and supply chain software companies.

agenda.title: What changed in sender rules this year
agenda.note: What the big mailbox providers check now, and what it means for daily volume.

agenda.title: Three teams, three setups
agenda.note: How three outbound teams changed domains, warmup and volume, and what happened to replies.

agenda.note: Bring a setup you're unsure about. We'll go through as many as we can.

data.why_now: Grew its outbound team from two SDRs to six this quarter.
